summary: Prepared the lean current-cycle-13 H1 package for independent H2 audit. It preserves actual H1/H2 probes, original raw captures and first failures, the one-assertion green-01 correction chronology, R1803 review, E1804's current source-build receipt/log, native assignment records, root qualifications, and exact inert source snapshots. The package contains 118 hash-and-length-listed payload files plus the manifest and this native result (120 regular files total). It does not include old-cycle evidence, historical site.evidence, screenshots, .dist output, or the accidental PageRouter/hh-cycle13 scratch tree.
